name: Look'n'Feel
author: Santiago Villabona (MeperDonas)
description: Tune Hyprland's look'n'feel from the bar: opacity of the focused window and the ones behind, corner rounding, inner and outer gaps, border width, blur, shadows and animations. It applies live while you drag (Hyprland's IPC socket), persists into a managed block of ~/.config/hypr/looknfeel.lua, with a reset per control and a global reset, a UI click on every change, and a panel in English or Spanish.

barWidget.description: Hyprland's opacity, rounding, gaps, border, blur, shadows and animations, applied live and with a reset per control.

schema.label: Sound
schema.description: Short click when a switch changes, when a control is reset and when a slider is released. Off, the effect is not even loaded.

schema.label: Icon
schema.description: Nerd Font glyph for the bar icon. Defaults to md-tune (U+F062E); md-window_restore (U+F05B2) and md-palette (U+F03D8) also fit.

schema.label: looknfeel command
schema.description: Empty = the CLI that ships inside the plugin. Set it only to point somewhere else.
